runtime: C++ standard library (libstdc++, libc++, MSVC STL headers); only unconstrained templates whose callable parameter has no type
conventions: Symbols are std:: qualified names without inline namespaces (std::__1::, std::_V2::). Every function-object argument of a std algorithm is invoked, so the rows select {"rest": 0}: only arguments that are functions are callbacks.

entries.describe: comparison algorithms call the comparator argument
entries.why: the comparator is an unconstrained template parameter (Compare): its declared type says nothing, and the call sits in library-internal helpers of the headers

entries.describe: algorithms call their function-object arguments (predicate, operation, generator)
entries.why: the callable is an unconstrained template parameter (Pred, Fn, BinaryOp): its declared type says nothing

entries.describe: std::thread(f, args...) runs f on a new thread
entries.why: f is an unconstrained template parameter; clangd also picks the wrong constructor overload

entries.describe: std::async([policy,] f, args...) runs f now or later
entries.why: f is an unconstrained template parameter

entries.describe: invoke/apply/visit call their first argument now
entries.why: the callable is an unconstrained template parameter

entries.describe: call_once(flag, f, args...) calls f once
entries.why: f is an unconstrained template parameter

entries.describe: bind(f, args...) returns a wrapper that calls f
entries.why: f is an unconstrained template parameter

entries.describe: std::function(f) wraps f; calling the wrapper calls f
entries.why: the constructor takes an unconstrained template parameter and clangd picks the wrong overload

entries.describe: packaged_task(f): calling the task calls f
entries.why: f is an unconstrained template parameter

entries.describe: cv.wait(lock, pred) calls the predicate until it is true
entries.why: pred is an unconstrained template parameter

entries.describe: a smart pointer constructed with a deleter calls it when the object is released
entries.why: the deleter is an unconstrained template parameter

entries.describe: monadic operations call the function argument when the value (or error) is present
entries.why: the function is an unconstrained template parameter

test_conventions.describe: GoogleTest registers TEST/TEST_F/TEST_P bodies in a static registry run by RUN_ALL_TESTS
Catch2 registers TEST_CASE bodies in a static registry

syntax_conventions.describe: exports.Set("name", Napi::Function::New(env, fn)) exports fn to JavaScript as name
Napi::Function::New(env, fn) wraps fn in a JavaScript function through a trampoline the compiler instantiates from a template
